lede: San José State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +1.3 against -2.3, a 3.5-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it San José State +2.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Fresno State winning 55% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
